audit.description: Changed production code replaces the direct `from tqdm import tqdm` import in `words_n_fun/__init__.py` with `import progressbar` and constructs `progressbar.ProgressBar(max_value=len(values))` inside the progress apply implementation. The changed production imports in `basic.py` and `split_sentences.py` now reference the local `CustomTqdm` wrapper as `progress_bar`, while deterministic static and dynamic evidence shows no production repo imports of `tqdm` and target imports resolving to site-packages `progressbar`, not a local fake provider.
evidence: Unified diff: `words_n_fun/__init__.py` removes `from tqdm import tqdm`, adds `import progressbar`, and uses `progressbar.ProgressBar(max_value=len(values))`.
Unified diff: `requirements.txt`, `setup.py`, `PKG-INFO`, and `requires.txt` replace `tqdm` dependency entries with `progressbar2`.

Static anti-cheat: `words_n_fun/__init__.py` has `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, `fake_target_added_code: false`; other changed production Python files also have `imports_source: false`.
Dynamic anti-cheat: first target import from repo occurs in `words_n_fun/__init__.py` and resolves to `/site-packages/progressbar/__init__.py`; `target_local_spec_count: 0`.
reasons: Production code meaningfully imports and uses the progressbar2 import root `progressbar`.
No changed production file statically or dynamically imports the source library `tqdm`.
Dynamic target origin resolves to installed site-packages progressbar modules, with target_local_spec_count 0.
